channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Designing for Dual Screen and Foldable Devices With CSS
item.description: Revisiting the CSS media queries and environment variables for foldable devices. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Wiring Up Components with Typed attr() and Container Style Queries
item.description: Wiring HTML attributes into CSS with advanced typed attr(), and letting container style queries pass that state down to child components. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Animating CSS Grid Layouts with CSS Anchor Positioning
item.description: At CSS Day (back in June), someone asked me how Brave (the browser) might have built their New Tab Page which features some tiles laid out in a grid. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Building an Infinite Liquid Glass Grid with Three.js, WebGPU, and TSL
item.description: An exploration of infinite grids, liquid glass, and video refraction using Three.js, WebGPU, TSL, and custom shaders. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Drawably: Hand-Drawn UI Controls
item.description: Hand-drawn UI controls. Every mount a fresh pen sketch. Zero dependencies. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Testing Cookie Behavior Across Hundreds of Web Surfaces with an In-House Auditor
item.description: Our cookie auditor acts like a privacy-conscious user by visiting web pages and checking that they only load cookies consistent with that user’s preferences. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: How the Chrome Dino Game Works: A Tour of Chromium's Source
